title: Personality Development and Soft Skills
sources_used: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define "Transferable Skills" with one example. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Transferable Skills: Transferable skills are abilities that can be applied across different jobs or
  • situations, such as communication skills used in both academic presentations and workplace meetings.
  • (CO1 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how to use Visual Aids without distracting the audience. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Visual Aids: Visual aids should be simple, relevant, and used to support key points so that they
  • enhance understanding without diverting the audience’s attention from the speaker. (CO4 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define social stress / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Social Stress: Social stress refers to the pressure or tension experienced by individuals due to
  • interactions, expectations, or conflicts within social relationships or social environments. (CO3 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is rational problem solving? / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Rational Problem Solving: Rational problem solving is a systematic process of identifying a
  • problem, analysing possible solutions, and selecting the most logical and effective option. (CO5 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is logical reasoning? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Logical Reasoning: Logical reasoning is the ability to analyse information and draw valid
  • conclusions based on structured thinking and evidence. (CO1 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define Soft Skills and explain their significance in the 21st-century workplace. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Soft Skills: Soft skills are personal and interpersonal abilities such as communication, teamwork,
  • and adaptability that are essential for effective functioning in the 21st-century workplace. (CO1 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is stage fear? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Stage Fear: Stage fear is the anxiety or nervousness a person experiences while speaking or
  • performing in front of an audience. (CO3 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is stress management? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Stress Management: Stress management refers to techniques and strategies used to control and
  • reduce stress in order to maintain mental and physical well-being. (CO3 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Name the first step in the Rational Decision-Making Model. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• First Step in Rational Decision-Making Model: The first step in the rational decision -making
  • model is identifying and clearly defining the problem. (CO5 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the General Adaptation Syndrome (GAS) stages. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• General Adaptation Syndrome: General Adaptation Syndrome consists of three stages—alarm,
  • resistance, and exhaustion—through which the body responds to prolonged stress. (CO3 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is Primary Appraisal? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Primary Appraisal: Primary appraisal is the stage in stress evaluation where an individual
  • assesses whether a situation is threatening, harmful, or challenging. (CO3 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Relate the concept of 'Locus of Control' to your own approach to academic success. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Locus of Control and Academic Success: Locus of control relates to academic success by
  • determining whether a student believes achievements depend on personal effort (internal locus) or
  • external factors. (CO2 – A)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How does Social Stress differ from Occupational Stress? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Social vs Occupational Stress: Social stress arises from interpersonal relationships and social
  • expectations, whereas occupational stress originates from job -related pressures and work
  • environments. (CO3 – An)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define Bounded Rationality in decision-making. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Bounded Rationality: Bounded rationality refers to the idea that decision -making is limited by
  • the information available, time constraints, and the cognitive capacity of individuals. (CO5 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is stress reaction? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Stress Reaction: Stress reaction is the physical, emotional, or psychological response that occurs
  • when an individual faces challenging or demanding situations. (CO3 – U)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is self-awareness? / [CO2] [2x13 = 26]
questions.solution_html:
• Self-Awareness: Self-awareness is the ability to recognize and understand one’s own emotions,
  • strengths, weaknesses, and behaviour. (CO2 – K)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: "Personal branding is the bridge between soft skills and career success." Evaluate this statement in the context of interview performance. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Personal Branding and Interview Performance: Personal branding reflects how an individual
  • presents their skills, values, and personality to others, especially during interviews. Strong soft skills
  • such as communication, confidence, and professionalism help candidates effectively demonstrate their
  • personal brand. Therefore, personal branding becomes a bridge connecting soft skills with career
  • opportunities and interview success. (CO4 – E)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Analyse how emotional intelligence influences interpersonal relationships. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Emotional Intelligence and Interpersonal Relationships: Emotional intelligence enables
  • individuals to understand and manage their own emotions while empathizing with others. This helps
  • in effective communication, conflict resolution, and maintaining healthy relationships. As a result,
  • emotionally intelligent individuals build stronger and more cooperative interpersonal relationships.
  • (CO4 – An)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Design innovative solutions for workplace problems / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Innovative Solutions for Workplace Problems: Innovative solutions for workplace problems
  • may include promoting open communication, encouraging teamwork, and adopting digital tools to
  • improve productivity. Organizations can also implement training programs to enhance employees’
  • problem-solving and creative thinking skills. Such strategies foster a positive work environment and
  • improve overall efficiency. (CO5 – C)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Create a "Corporate Wellness Program" proposal that addresses both individual and organizational stress. / [CO3] [6x4 = 24]
questions.solution_html:
• Corporate Wellness Program Proposal: A corporate wellness program should include
  • stress-management workshops, physical fitness initiatives, and counselling support for employees.
  • Organizations can also promote flexible work schedules and healthy workplace environments. Such
  • programs enhance employee well -being while improving productivity and organizational
  • performance. (CO3 – C)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
